title: Dawn Patrol
meta_description: Find the perfect Grayton Beach, FL vacation rental at ‘Dawn Patrol’ a Luxury 6 Bedroom, 4 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 19 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Endless Gulf Views, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 6 Bedrooms • 4 Full Baths • SQFT: 3448 • Stories: 4 • Elevator • Gulf Views • Heated Private Pool & Sun Deck (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Sleeps 19 • Parking for 5 Cars • Six Seater Golf Cart Included • Six Adult Bikes Included DESCRIPTION: Nestled just steps from the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of Grayton Beach, ‘Dawn Patrol’ is a luxurious 6-bedroom, 4-bathroom retreat designed for relaxation, adventure, and unforgettable memories. With breathtaking Gulf views, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location in one of Florida’s most cherished beach towns, this property offers the ultimate coastal getaway. The private pool, complete with a flat-screen TV and an enclosed outdoor shower, provides the ideal space for lounging and refreshing after a day at the beach. Three expansive decks showcase sweeping Gulf views, perfect for enjoying morning coffee, dining under the stars, or savoring a stunning sunset. To make exploring effortless, guests can take advantage of the 6-person golf cart and 7 adult bikes, while the in-home elevator ensures ease and accessibility throughout your stay. Inside, the second floor features a chef’s kitchen equipped with a gas range, custom cabinetry, and granite countertops. Adjacent, the dining area comfortably seats up to 12, while the spacious living room invites you to relax with plush seating and a large flat-screen TV. Step out onto the balcony to soak in the views or unwind in one of the two guest bedrooms on this floor—one with a king bed and another with two full beds—both sharing a bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The third floor offers ample space for families, with a second living area, a flat-screen TV, and triple stack bunk beds. Three additional bedrooms, each with a queen bed, provide cozy accommodations. The balcony on this level, complete with a swing bed and lounge seating, offers yet another vantage point to admire the Gulf. The fourth floor is a private oasis, featuring a primary bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, a queen sleeper sofa in the living area, and access to a secluded balcony with unparalleled ocean views. With ample space to sleep up to 19 guests, ‘Dawn Patrol’ is thoughtfully designed to cater to large groups while maintaining an inviting and luxurious atmosphere. Located in the heart of Grayton Beach, this retreat places you close to vibrant local dining, shopping, and the natural beauty of the Timpoochee Trail. Whether you’re lounging by the pool, exploring the charming beach town, or simply taking in the coastal views, ‘Dawn Patrol’ promises a vacation filled with relaxation and adventure. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 19) SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 6) • Bedroom 1: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & Shared Bathroom – Single Vanity with Shower/Tub Combo • Bedroom 2: Two Full Beds (Sleeps 4) & Shared Bathroom - Single Vanity with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 9) • Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom with Queen Bed (sleeps 2) & Shared Bathroom – Single Vanity with Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 4: Guest Bedroom with Queen Bed (sleeps 2) & Shared Bathroom – Single Vanity with Shower/Tub Combo • Bedroom 5: Guest Bedroom with Queen Bed (sleeps 2) & Shared Bathroom – Single Vanity with Shower/Tub Combo • Additional Living Space with Triple Bunk (Sleeps 3) FOURTH FLOOR: (Sleeps 4) • Bedroom 6: Primary Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) + Additional Living Space with Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities with Modern Walk-in Shower. Plus Private Balcony with Endless Gulf Views. LAYOUT: FIRST FLOOR/OUTDOOR AREA: • Heated Pool with Swim Up Bar • Grilling Station • Bar Area with Sink, TV & Fridge (Plus 2 Barstools) • Dining Table Seats 6 • Entryway to Stairs & Elevator SECOND FLOOR: • Main Living Area • Two Sofas & 2 Arm Chairs • Kitchen with Culinary Appliances & Island Seats 5 • Dining Table Seats 12 • Expansive Balcony with Seating Area & Outdoor Dining for 6 • Guest Bedroom 1 & 2 • Shared Full Bath THIRD FLOOR: • Guest Bedroom 3, 4, & 5 • 2 Full Baths • Additional Living Space with Large Sectional • Bunk Nook with Triple Stack Bunk • Balcony with Seating Area & Day Bed Swing • Laundry Facilities FOURTH FLOOR: • Primary Suite with Ensuite Bathroom • Additional Seating Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa • Private Balcony with Bar Table & 4 Sun Loungers
